# Dev Directory

> A comprehensive, highly-curated directory of nearly 600 AI models, developer APIs, codebase understanding tools, and tech platforms.

This directory categorizes and indexes modern developer and AI resources. 
You can visit the live directory at: https://simon-riley17.github.io/dev-tools-directory/

## Directory Structure

The directory is split into the following categories:
